column1: # Batch 45 — what each row actually did, measured (2026-10-19).
# Three readings per row, from three tools, because one tool's self-report is how 260 silent sources got
#   probe / probe_items / http      tools/probe_hp_batch.py — the endpoint answered, parsed in its declared
#                                   mode, and held real records. 164/164 PASS.
#                                   records into intel_items. `stored` is off the run line, `db_rows` is read
#                                   back out of the database: two independent readings. stored < emitted is
#                                   rule 4b's silent failure, and it is not present here — attributes.<the
#                                   layer's own objectIdField> is unique per record by ArcGIS's definition.
#                                   A row reading `not-swept` was not reached by this sweep; the batch-level
#                                   reading for all 164 is audit_batch_emit.py: OK=161, SLOW=3 (unmeasured at
#                                   a 240 s kill line, not failed — the three largest layers), 1,790,908
#   upstream_count                  the layer's own /query?returnCountOnly=true, which is what a page count
#                                   has to be judged against. `cycles` marks the 34 rows whose collection is
#                                   larger than one 20-page run can take, so they read it over a cycle.
# page_size is the layer's OWN maxRecordCount capped at 2000, and the URL's resultRecordCount equals it on
# every row. geom decides what geometry was asked for: point and polyline keep full WGS84 geometry, polygon
# asks for a centroid (rings measured 64x the payload), a non-spatial table asks for none.
